name: expandable-screen

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the expanded panel with the large photo, full heading, copy and button all crisp.

tagline: A small photo card blooms into a full-screen panel.
summary: A preview card with a photo, title and Tap to expand hint that morphs into a near full-screen panel with a bigger photo, heading, copy and a Get Started button. An X collapses it back to the card.
appearance: Collapsed, a rounded dark card holds a yellow-lit pug photo above a bold title, two grey lines and a small Tap to expand link. Expanded, a near full-screen dark panel centres the same photo much larger over a white heading, grey copy and a white pill button.
behaviour: Clicking the card morphs its rounded frame out into the full panel while the small content fades away and the larger view fades in. The X in the corner collapses it back; the demo's copy also mentions Escape, but no key handler is wired.
demo_content: Pug photo; the card says Expand to Full Screen and the panel says Full Screen Experience with a Get Started button.
search_phrases: card that opens into a full screen page
click a card to expand it large
morphing modal from a preview tile
full screen overlay from a card
smooth zoom from thumbnail to page
use_when: A preview tile should open into an immersive detail view with a smooth shared-element morph.
avoid_when: Keyboard users must open and exit easily: the preview is not focusable and the Escape hint is not implemented.
customise: defaultExpanded, onExpandChange, layoutId, triggerRadius, contentRadius, animationDuration and lockScroll are root props; the card and panel content are children.
weight_why: A shared-layout motion transition between two small trees; no media loop.

a11y.note: The clickable preview is a div with no button role or tab stop, and the promised Escape key is never implemented.

issues: The panel copy promises Escape collapses it, but no key handler is implemented.
The close X uses the foreground colour on a dark panel, so it nearly disappears.
polish_why: Smooth shared-element morph; the invisible close X and the broken Escape hint are the flaws.
title: Expandable Screen
